title: Feature test generation config
description: Global, cross-feature configuration for the test-generation pipeline (`.dev/lib/proman/test/gen/`). Contains no per-feature data — feature-specific facts needed to generate correct tests (functional smoke-test command, version pins) live in each feature's own `metadata.yaml` under `_options.verify.functional`/`_options.version.test_pins`.

enabled.description: Master kill switch for the entire generation pipeline. When false, `load_effective()` returns only hand-written scenarios/checks, unchanged from today.

rollout.description: Migration-only scaffolding controlling which features generation applies to. Retired (set to `all` with an empty/small permanent `denylist`) once every feature has been individually reviewed.

mode.description: `allowlist`: only features in `allowlist` get generated content. `denylist`: every feature except those in `denylist` gets generated content. `all`: every feature gets generated content (denylist still applies, for permanently-excluded features like install-os-pkg).

allowlist.description: Feature ids to generate tests for, when mode is `allowlist`.

denylist.description: Feature ids to never generate tests for (e.g. install-os-pkg, install — manifest-DSL/orchestration features with no metadata shape the generator keys off).

environments.description: Pointers to keys already defined in test/environments.yaml — no environment data is duplicated here.

primary.description: Default environment for scenario families that only need one (e.g. `default`, `version_pinning`).

nonroot_env.description: Environment with a pre-created non-root user, used by nonroot prefix/configure_users scenarios.

npm_env.description: Environment with Node.js/npm pre-installed, used by method_matrix's npm_default. 'npm already installed' isn't a WhenSpec-expressible attribute, so this is a direct pointer rather than a when:-driven pool selection.

pool.description: Candidate environments for multi-environment selection (e.g. method_matrix's package_default, one per plat.pm). Deliberately a curated list, not every test/environments.yaml key — the file also contains many special-purpose `+tool[-version]`/`+toolchain` layers (pre-installed tool states, build toolchains) that are never appropriate as a generic 'which OS represents this package manager' pick, and some base images (alpine/rocky/opensuse-leap) need their `+bash` variant here since generated checks use `bash -c '...'`.

families.description: Per-scenario-family generation settings, keyed by the family name a rule registers under (see `.dev/lib/proman/test/gen/rules/`).

enabled.description: Whether this family generates anything, globally. A feature's own scenarios.yaml `generation.suppress` can still remove individual generated scenarios/checks when this is true.

modes.description: Default `modes:` applied to every scenario this family generates.

select.description: Environment-selection policy for families that may span multiple environments (currently only `method_matrix`'s `package_default`/`upstream_package_default`).

options.description: Enum-typed option names to generate invalid-value scenarios for (`invalid_enum` family only).

reason.description: Free-text justification, mainly documenting why a family is disabled.

assertions.description: Global strictness knobs applied by checks_builtin.py's shared check builders.

require_anchored_regex.description: Require boundary-anchored regexes in generated version-format/version-value checks (never a bare unanchored digit pattern).

version_cross_validate.description: Generate exact-value version checks (not just format checks) wherever a specific version is known (pinned/legacy test_pins, if_exists reinstall/update target).

functional_smoke_required.description: Fail generation loudly for any feature with `_options.method`/`_options.version` that has not declared `_options.verify.functional`, instead of silently generating weaker checks.
